_meta.reference_spec: REPLACE ME — the one sentence defining what is priced/measured on every row, e.g. 'cheapest plan with >=2 vCPU, >=4 GB RAM, >=40 GB SSD'. Without this the rows are not comparable.
_meta.scales: REPLACE ME — say which end of each 1-5 rating is good, e.g. 'strictness/risk: 1=best. quality/reliability: 5=best.'
_meta.note: confidence=low means the figure is plausible but was not confirmed against a live source. The report must surface this next to the number.
_meta.availability_note: `availability` is whether the priced option can actually be BOUGHT right now, which is not the same question as whether it is any good. Price it from the standing catalogue, not from a promo or a 'starting at' banner: the cheapest row in a comparison is very often the one nobody can order.
